phone.caption: Welcome: create an account or sign in
Create your account, with a referral code if you have one
Confirm your email with a 4-digit code
Optional: create a server key to sync across your devices
Choose a plan and pay with M-Pesa
A reminder before your plan ends, with one-tap renew
Renew in one tap: your plan and M-Pesa number are ready
Browse what’s trending, with no ads
